results.name: Honeywell International Inc.
results.description: Honeywell Technologies Inc. (formerly Honeywell International Inc.) is a multinational conglomerate corporation which primarily operates in four areas of business: aerospace, building technologies, performance materials and technologies, and safety and productivity solutions. It was founded on May 13th 1985. On December 1, 1999, the company completed a reverse merger with Honeywell Inc. and changed its name.

results.name: Hon Hai Precision Industry Co. Ltd.
results.description: Hon Hai Precision Industry Co. Ltd. (DBA as Foxconn) is engaged in the manufacture, sale, and service of connectors, case, thermal module, wired/wireless communication products, optical products, power supply modules, and assemblies in Taiwan and internationally. The company was founded in 1974.

results.name: Hong Kong Exchanges & Clearing Ltd.
results.description: Hong Kong Exchanges & Clearing Ltd. engages in the operation of stock and futures markets. The company was founded on July 8, 1999, and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
